title: MaleTheme Duo #024 · 남 피트니스 모델·아이돌 내추럴·군인 테마 / 남 클래식 머슬·골드 글리터·검투사 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a waist-high wall, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Swedish man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, natural idol makeup with soft brown eyeshadow and a tinted lip, very pale smooth skin with a cool undertone, a gentle soft smile, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a silver miniature anvil, a lead barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered gold hair ornaments. Extremely long stiletto nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a tilted olive-green military beret with a brass badge, two silver dog-tag chains hanging on his bare chest, and a minimal camouflage-pattern T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme silver needle heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Thai man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, metallic gold glitter eyeshadow with defined lashes, smooth golden-tan skin, a cool composed look, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (an iron ship's anchor, a silver miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold ship's anchor, a silver miniature anvil, a copper hammer head, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, an iron pyramid-shaped lump, a gold barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three platinum rings. Extremely long oval nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a polished bronze gladiator helmet with a tall red crest, criss-crossing thin leather straps with bronze studs over his bare chest, bronze arm bracers, and a minimal bronze-studded brown leather T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his stomach bare.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme black platform stiletto Mary Janes, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
